game.q: deep in the grief, the poet turns. what does he say?

wrong.delete: he kept every word. the grief stays in.
wrong.fine: that’s the “this is fine” dog. he was honest instead.

game.right: YES. right in the middle of the book, in the ruins: “this i call to mind, and so i have hope.”

end.line: the city was ash. the poet wrote hope anyway: new every morning.

cliff.s1: next week: a church falling out.
cliff.s2: the letter they got is now read at weddings.

share: a poet in a burned city wrote the line about mercy new every morning. the story on infinite hill
